name: furniture-drag-multitouch
description: BUG-1: a second finger's independent pointer stream must not hijack/teleport an in-progress furniture drag in the 3D scene. Starts a drag (recording pointerId 101, mirroring Furniture.tsx's onPointerDown), drives it with real pointermove/pointerup DOM events dispatched on window (the exact listeners DragController registers), and asserts a second pointer (id 202) moving/releasing is completely ignored: the item follows ONLY pointer 101, and only pointer 101's pointerup ends the drag.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: assert-drag-armed
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.draggingItemId!=='bug1-sofa')throw new Error('drag did not start');if(s.dragPointerId!==101)throw new Error('dragPointerId not recorded, got '+s.dragPointerId)})()

steps.name: capture-after-finger-1
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();const p=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='bug1-sofa').position;window.__bug1_afterFinger1=[...p];if(p[0]===window.__bug1_pos0[0]&&p[1]===window.__bug1_pos0[1])throw new Error('item did not move for the initiating pointer (101) — floor raycast may have missed; check camera framing')})()

steps.name: assert-second-finger-ignored
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();const p=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='bug1-sofa').position;const a=window.__bug1_afterFinger1;if(p[0]!==a[0]||p[1]!==a[1])throw new Error('BUG-1 REGRESSION: item followed the second finger (pointerId 202) — expected it to stay at '+JSON.stringify(a)+' but got '+JSON.stringify(p));if(s.draggingItemId!=='bug1-sofa')throw new Error('drag was cleared by the second finger')})()

steps.name: assert-drag-still-active-after-finger-2-up
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.draggingItemId!=='bug1-sofa')throw new Error('BUG-1 REGRESSION: the second finger (pointerId 202) releasing ended the drag — only the initiating pointer (101) may end it');if(s.dragPointerId!==101)throw new Error('dragPointerId was clobbered, got '+s.dragPointerId)})()

steps.name: assert-finger-1-still-drives
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();const p=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='bug1-sofa').position;const a=window.__bug1_afterFinger1;if(p[0]===a[0]&&p[1]===a[1])throw new Error('finger 1 (pointerId 101) stopped driving the drag after finger 2 touched down — pointer 101 should still be live');window.__bug1_afterFinger1Again=[...p]})()

steps.name: assert-drag-ended-by-initiating-pointer
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.draggingItemId!==null)throw new Error('drag did not end on the initiating pointer (101) releasing, draggingItemId='+s.draggingItemId);if(s.dragPointerId!==null)throw new Error('dragPointerId was not cleared on endDrag, got '+s.dragPointerId)})()
